svg.title: World Population pipeline architecture
svg.desc: Pipeline from World Bank CSVs through Snowpipe ingestion, CDC streams, UNPIVOT stored procedure, dynamic table DAG, and SQL reporting views.

g.text: Continuous ingestion · internal stages · named file formats
Wide format — 1 row per country · 60+ year columns
Fires only when SYSTEM$STREAM_HAS_DATA = true · Stored procedure: UNPIVOT wide → long
Long format — 1 row per country / year / indicator

svg.text: 195+ countries · 60+ years · 4 datasets · 5-min refresh · <$20 on free trial
